tools.name: robot.get_ee_pose
tools.summary: Get the end-effector pose in world frame.
tools.returns: {"pose": {"position": {x, y, z}, "rotation": {w, x, y, z}}}

tools.name: robot.get_gripper
tools.summary: Get the gripper open fraction (0 closed, 1 open).
tools.returns: {"position": fraction}, 0 closed to 1 open

tools.name: robot.describe_gripper
tools.summary: The hand's geometry: span, axes, pads, housing.
tools.returns: span_m, min_grasp_width_m, max_grasp_width_m, close_axis, approach_axis, finger, kind, arm, arm_id

tools.name: robot.describe_workspace
tools.summary: Derived heights and clearances for this robot in this cell.
tools.returns: surface_z, transport_z, transport_above_surface_m, align_clearance_m, pregrasp_standoff_m, margin_m, arm, arm_id

tools.name: robot.grasp_frame
tools.summary: A grasp orientation built from this hand's measured axes.
tools.returns: {"arm", "rotation", "rotation_flipped", "approach", "close_axis"}. close_heading_deg is the world heading, in degrees, the jaws close along; approach defaults to straight down

tools.name: robot.go_to_pose
tools.summary: Move the end-effector to a world-frame pose via IK.
tools.returns: nothing; blocks until the servo settles. The wrist roll is not held

tools.name: robot.go_to_pose_cartesian
tools.summary: Move the end-effector along a straight Cartesian line.
tools.returns: nothing; same servo along a straight line. The wrist roll is not held

tools.name: robot.execute_trajectory
tools.summary: Execute a joint trajectory waypoint-by-waypoint.
tools.returns: nothing; runs a motion.* plan's trajectory

tools.name: robot.open_gripper
tools.summary: Open the gripper and let physics settle.
tools.returns: {"position": fraction}

tools.name: robot.close_gripper
tools.summary: Close the gripper and let physics settle.
tools.returns: {"position": fraction}; near 0 means the fingers met each other

tools.name: robot.set_grip
tools.summary: Drive the jaws to a width, an object's width, or a named preset.
tools.returns: requested_width_m, command_width_m, clamped, reason, fraction_closed, waited, arm, arm_id. Ramped over ramp_steps

tools.name: robot.go_home
tools.summary: Move all arms to the home joint configuration.
tools.returns: nothing

tools.name: robot.wait_steps
tools.summary: Hold position while the scene runs on for a number of steps.
tools.returns: nothing; holds position for steps control steps

tools.name: robot.move_to_joints
tools.summary: Move the arm to a joint configuration, blocking until converged.
tools.returns: nothing; blocks until converged

tools.name: robot.solve_ik
tools.summary: Solve IK for a world-frame pose; returns a joint configuration.
tools.returns: a joint configuration for the pose

tools.name: motion.plan_linear
tools.summary: Plan a straight line to a pose, holding the axes the move is not along.
tools.returns: planned, reason, position_error_m, trajectory ({"waypoints": [{"positions": [...]}, ...]}). orientation is "axis" (wrist free, default) or "lock" (full rotation held)

tools.name: motion.plan_joint
tools.summary: Plan an eased joint-space move to a pose, and say how near it got.
tools.returns: planned, reason, position_error_m, rotation_error_rad, trajectory. The argument is pose, not end

tools.name: sim.get_object_pose
tools.summary: One object's ground-truth world pose (position + wxyz quaternion).
tools.returns: {"name", "pose": {"position", "rotation"}}; refuses fixtures

tools.name: sim.get_object_obb
tools.summary: One object's oriented bounding box and the grasp it implies.
tools.returns: obb {center, extent (half), orientation}, grasp_obb, grasp_position, grasp_heading_deg, grasp_width, fits_gripper, top_z, bottom_z; refuses fixtures

tools.name: sim.get_object_bounds
tools.summary: One object's world axis-aligned bounds, as it lies now.
tools.returns: name, min, max, lowest_z, highest_z, long_axis; refuses fixtures

tools.name: sim.list_objects
tools.summary: Every manipulable object in the scene, with its category.
tools.returns: {"objects": [{"name", "category", "static"}, ...]}

tools.name: sim.list_regions
tools.summary: Every goal region, with its world centre.
tools.returns: {"regions": [{"name", "frame", "center"}, ...]}

tools.name: sim.get_region_obb
tools.summary: One goal region as an oriented bounding box, for aiming a place.
tools.returns: {"name", "obb": {center, extent (half), orientation}}: the region's own volume near its floor
